approaches_tried.approach: Mutation 2's fixture-H test using a freshly-created scratch copy directory (REPO_H_MUT under a different mktemp path) so the original fixture H stays byte-identical for reuse
approaches_tried.reason: The scratch copy's absolute path differs from REPO_H's, but the mutation reused HOME_H (whose .claude.json keys the project entry under REPO_H's own path). Querying from the scratch copy's directory made $(pwd) resolve to the scratch path, which has NO entry in HOME_H's .projects -- Check 2 (absent entry) failed instead of exercising Check 9, giving a false FAIL for the wrong reason. Fixed by overwriting REPO_H's OWN deployed verifier in place after confirming mutation 1 no longer needs the original file, so the querying path and the config key always match.
